title: Slow Art
content: Yesterday's post included this line by Augustus Saint-Gaudens: "A good thing is no better for being done quickly."This prompted a very interesting rhetorical question by portrait painterIlaria Roselli del Turco:"But is a good thing any better for being done slowly?"Have a look at this video "A Slow Art" by art criticRobert Hughesand let me know what you think.
